channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK, Norway deepen naval pact as Russian activity rises
item.description: The UK and Norway have agreed to intensify joint operations in the North Atlantic in response to a documented 30 percent rise in Russian naval activity near UK waters over the past two years. The post UK, Norway deepen naval pact as Russian activity rises first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD weighs UK production in future Hawk replacement
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that no decision has yet been made on whether a future replacement for the Hawk fast jet trainer will be built in the UK. The post MOD weighs UK production in future Hawk replacement first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: No plans for new offences on impersonating service personnel
item.description: Labour MP Euan Stainbank asked whether the Ministry of Defence had assessed the merits of criminalising impersonating service personnel. The post No plans for new offences on impersonating service personnel first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British-built AI satellites reach orbit on SpaceX mission
item.description: A cluster of British-designed intelligence satellites has entered low Earth orbit following a launch aboard SpaceX’s Transporter-15 rideshare mission. The post British-built AI satellites reach orbit on SpaceX mission first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK sanctions Russian GRU after Kremlin linked to attack
item.description: The UK has imposed sweeping sanctions on Russia'a military intelligence agency, the GRU, after the final report of the Dawn Sturgess Inquiry concluded that Putin personally authorised the Salisbury operation that killed a British citizen. The post UK sanctions Russian GRU after Kremlin linked to attack first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO chief tells Putin ‘we are not going anywhere’
item.description: NATO foreign ministers have endorsed work on a path toward spending 5 percent of national GDP on defence and reaffirmed continued support for Ukraine. The post NATO chief tells Putin ‘we are not going anywhere’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Meteor integration advances on F-35A after ground tests
item.description: Images released by the programme show Meteor installed inside the bay of an F-35A while technicians measured its behaviour at varying vibration frequencies. The post Meteor integration advances on F-35A after ground tests first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK explains delay to F-35B SRVL upgrade
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has moved to clarify the status of the Shipborne Rolling Vertical Landing system for the UK’s F-35B Lightning II jets. The post UK explains delay to F-35B SRVL upgrade first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Pro-Palestine attack reduces RAF tanker engines service life
item.description: Damage sustained during a Pro-Palestine attack at RAF Brize Norton has left two RAF Voyager engines with shortened cleared life, forcing the RAF to bring forward major maintenance. The post Pro-Palestine attack reduces RAF tanker engines service life first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Unidentified drones breach Irish airspace on Zelenskyy visit
item.description: Irish security services are examining a significant drone incursion that occurred during the arrival of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin. The post Unidentified drones breach Irish airspace on Zelenskyy visit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
